# Willow & Grain

Willow & Grain designs furniture and home goods for people furnishing apartments and family homes. The catalog sells directly to individual consumers. There is no business plan, no team workspace, and no software product.

## Shop

Browse sofas, dining tables, linen bedding, and ceramic lighting. Every piece ships to your door. Free delivery on orders over $150.

## Collections

- The Oak Room — solid oak dining tables from $890.
- Sunday Sofa — performance fabric sofas from $1,240.
- Linen House — bedding and throws for the bedroom.
